prompt.content:
Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

When I first moved to college, I was surprised that both my roommates, a Malian boy and a Libyan boy, actually used to write detailed letters to their parents back home and not talk as much on the phone. This was for very different reasons though. The Malian boy was doing it purely as an exercise to improve writing skills but the Libyan boy often had connectivity issues back home. Whose parents didn't have great phone connectivity at home?
A. The Libyan boy
B. The Malian boy
C. Cannot be determined
